# Cinegma Films

> Cinegma Films LLC is an independent film production company in Karachi, Pakistan,
> founded by director/editor/colorist Syed Asad Raza Abidi. Its short film Janjaal
> (Tussle) won 14 international awards across 9 countries and screened theatrically
> at Arena Cinemas, Karachi. The studio also offers commercial video production
> services across Karachi and Pakistan.

Key facts:
- Founder: Syed Asad Raza Abidi (IMDb: https://www.imdb.com/name/nm16938510/)
- Flagship film: Janjaal (Tussle), 24-min psychological thriller, shot in 34 hours (IMDb: https://www.imdb.com/title/tt35505024/)
- 14 international awards · 22 festival selections · 9 countries
- Contact: info@cinegmafilms.com

## Janjaal (Tussle) — Pakistani short film
- [Janjaal — official film page](https://cinegmafilms.com/projects/janjaal.html): Overview, story, cast, awards, FAQ. Janjaal (Urdu: جنجال, English title: Tussle) is a 2024 Pakistani Urdu-language psychological thriller short film (24 min) directed by Syed Asad Raza Abidi, written by Ameer Hamza with Basil Hussain Zaidi, produced by Faizan Ahmed, starring Shamoon Abbasi, Nazish Ali and Danish Irshad. Premiered at Arena Cinemas, Karachi on 5 January 2025. 14 international awards, 22 selections, 9 countries.
- [Janjaal trailer](https://cinegmafilms.com/projects/janjaal-trailer.html): Official trailer (Best Trailer, TMFF Scotland 2025)
- [Janjaal cast & crew](https://cinegmafilms.com/projects/janjaal-cast-and-crew.html): Full credits
- [Janjaal awards](https://cinegmafilms.com/projects/janjaal-awards.html): Every award and festival selection
- [Making of Janjaal](https://cinegmafilms.com/projects/janjaal-making-of.html): Shot in 34 hours on Sunhera Beach, Karachi
- [جنجال — اردو](https://cinegmafilms.com/projects/janjaal-urdu.html): Urdu-language page

## Portrait of Life — Pakistani short film
- [Portrait of Life — official film page](https://cinegmafilms.com/projects/portrait-of-life.html): 2025 Pakistani thesis short film (11m34s) written, directed, edited and colour graded by Syed Asad Raza Abidi, produced by Dayyan Khalid, starring Umeza Irfan and Zuhair Zubair. A painter struggles to portray his wife the way he once did. Official Selection, Anymusic Film Festival (Spain); Best Trailer nominee, TMFF (Scotland).
- [Portrait of Life — teaser](https://cinegmafilms.com/projects/portrait-of-life-trailer.html): Official teaser

## Zawaal — upcoming Pakistani short film
- [Zawaal — official film page](https://cinegmafilms.com/projects/zawaal.html): Upcoming Pakistani Urdu-language psychological thriller short film directed and edited by Syed Asad Raza Abidi, produced by Dayyan Khalid, written by Faizan Ahmed with Ameer Hamza, starring Ameed Akbar, Ali Buksh, Danish Irshad and Nazish Ali. In production; official 4K trailer released.
- [Zawaal — trailer](https://cinegmafilms.com/projects/zawaal-trailer.html): Official 4K trailer

## A Soldier Beside Me — upcoming Pakistani short film
- [A Soldier Beside Me — official film page](https://cinegmafilms.com/projects/a-soldier-beside-me.html): Upcoming Pakistani war drama short film written, directed and produced by Ameer Hamza, shot and edited by Syed Asad Raza Abidi, starring Syed Mati Mukhtalif and Muhammad Affan. Two soldiers question each other's fate on the frontline. In production; official trailer released.
- [A Soldier Beside Me — trailer](https://cinegmafilms.com/projects/a-soldier-beside-me-trailer.html): Official trailer
